description: Complete end-to-end audio recording and streaming implementation for Google Meet Bot. This feature enables the bot to capture audio from Google Meet sessions, process it into one-minute chunks, and stream it in real-time via WebSocket connections.
capabilities: Real-time audio capture from Google Meet sessions
MediaRecorder API integration with WebM/Opus format
notes: This feature provides a complete audio recording and streaming solution integrated with the existing Google Meet automation bot. All components work together to enable seamless audio capture and real-time transmission.
